summary: ONEOK Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $1,000,000,000 of common stock through BofA Securities as sales agent, with potential forward sale agreements with Bank of America, N.A. This is a routine capital-raising transaction under an existing shelf registration, not a special situation. The filing details mechanics of ATM sales, forward settlements, and compensation up to 2.0%. No acquisition, divestiture, or other corporate event is involved. The last sale price was $88.24 on August 3, 2026. Watch for potential dilution from ATM sales, but no risk-arb angle applies.
